deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a financial memorandum: a register of bond numbers drawn for redemption ('ausgeloost', 'zurück' = called back and repaid) from a Swedish mortgage-bond loan of Wexiö (Växjö, Småland), presumably a Småland mortgage-society (hypoteksförening) loan. Gauss held and tracked Swedish bonds of this kind. The previous page (60) has the same kind of list for another loan with series A–E and quarterly dates, and the next page has similar notes headed 'Ostgoth[?]', probably the Östergötland loan.

The structure is as follows. The bonds are in four series, A, B, C and D. Each series is numbered separately, up to about 1000.

1. Heading: 'Ausgeloosete Wexiö. Zurück 1/6 · 1/12 1850' means the bonds drawn for repayment on 1 June and 1 December 1850. The two drawings are merged into one list per series: A 4 numbers, B 11, C 11, D 11, all in ascending order. Several numbers are underlined in red ink: A 135, 465; B 35, 70, 427, 535, 730, 871; C 136, 271, 296, 297, 525; D 51, 297, 315, 816, 967. These are probably bonds Gauss owned, or ones he checked off as cashed (my interpretation).
2. 'Auf 1/6 1851', with the note '26te …', apparently the 26th drawing. Lists: A 3 numbers, B 5, C 5, D 4.
3. 'Auf 1/12 1851'. Lists: A 3, B 5, C 5, D 5.
4. Right-hand column, '1/6 1852 27te', i.e. the 27th drawing. It has four unlabelled rows, which by position correspond to A, B, C and D. The rows have 3, 5, 5 and 6 numbers.
5. 'Auf 1/12 1852'. Lists: A 3, B 5, C 5, D 7.

The drawings are half-yearly (June and December), each typically calling 3 A-, 5 B-, 5 C- and 4–7 D-bonds. Nothing is computed on the page; it is bookkeeping of lottery-redemption results.
errors: No mathematical content, so no mathematical errors. All lists are in ascending order within each series, as expected for transcribed drawing results. The D row of 1/12 1852 has 7 numbers, more than the other D rows (4–6). This may simply reflect a larger drawing; it is not necessarily a slip.

results.what: Register of redemption-lottery drawings (Wexiö/Växjö mortgage bonds, series A–D, June/December 1850–1852), with Gauss's red underlinings of particular numbers
results.modern_name: Personal financial record (bond redemption by lot)

deep.surprise_reason: Purely financial bookkeeping. Gauss's investments in bonds, including Swedish mortgage bonds, and his meticulous records of them are well known (e.g. from his estate and from studies of his finances). The page has no mathematical content.

transcription_corrections: Heading reads 'Ausgeloosete Wexiö. Zurück 1/6 · 1/12 1850'. The double underline in red belongs to the 1/12. Wexiö = Växjö.
After 'Auf 1/6 1851' the note is '26te' (26th drawing) followed by a fraction-like mark with 6 in the denominator. It is unclear, perhaps a repeated '1/6' or a symbol, and is not securely '6/6'.
In 'Auf 1/12 1851' the numerator is written as a dot-like 1. The reading 1/12 is correct.

The right-hand column under '1/6 1852 27te' consists of four unlabelled rows that correspond to series A, B, C and D. It is separated from the left column by a vertical rule, and a second vertical rule closes the 1/12 1852 block.
C row of 1/12 1852: the second number is 585, with the 5 overwritten; this agrees with the transcription.
Red underlinings in the 1850 block, which the transcription omits: A 135, 465; B 35, 70, 427, 535, 730, 871; C 136, 271, 296, 297, 525; D 51, 297, 315, 816, 967.
